content.rendered:
Kindergarten Play Days – Join us for one or both of these play dates to connect with other Kinder families, visit with our amazing Kinder teaching team and give your students a chance to socialize with some of their future classmates.  The Kinder teaching team have some fun activities planned.  This is open to all incoming Middleton kindergarten students and their families.   Play Days will take place on our school playground. July 18th and August 15th 6:30 pm – 7:30 pm. 

Kinder Ramp-Up – We will have three sessions, September 4th, September 5th and September 6th for our new incoming Kinder students.  One third of our Kinder students will attend on each of those days and all  kinder students will attend September 7th, 10th and 11th.  There will be no school for any kindergartners on Wednesday, September 12th.  All kinders will begin in their official classroom Thursday, September 13th.  Letters will be sent home in August with more information on what to expect and to inform you of which students will attend what day. 
All Kinder Students will attend regular school hours 7:55 – 2:15.
